package.name: frustum_detection
package.description:
Frustum-based 3D object detection node.
Subscribes to the scored point cloud published by the point_painting node (/painting/scored_cloud) and to the rectified camera image, then for each YOLO 2D instance mask projects the LiDAR points inside the frustum, applies PointPainting score filtering, runs intra-frustum DBSCAN, fits a 3D bounding box, and publishes detection results and visualisation topics.
